newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May trade gap $271 mln - O Globo newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May trade gap $271 mln - O Globo newspaper.

text.p: Brazil registered a trade deficit of $271 million in May, the lowest trade gap in 12 months, a newspaper said.
The lower trade deficit, down from $951 million in April, is largely the result of lower oil imports and a simultaneous increase in agricultural exports, O Globo said.
The May figures brought the trade deficit in the first five months of 1997 to $3.7 billion, O Globo said.
The official trade balance figures are due to be released by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce at 1100 local/1000 EDT/1400 GMT.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
